Below it the riveted front wall with door and window runs from rows 33 to 62, about 30 rows. The stovepipe is a thin vertical element on the roof and is too small to count as a major part. Only 1% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines lean visibly toward the neighbouring material (grey-blue and brown) and are not a uniform black sticker line. By eye, the zinc roof carries about 5 lightness steps with speckle, rust stains, rivet dots and lap seams. The riveted wall plates, window, door and firewood stack are each shaded in several tones. It has fewer raw colours overall (31 against 66 and 185) and slightly shallower ramps than the references, and its texture is less varied than the per-tile tile scallops. Even so, it is not flat or sticker-like, and it matches the references on the primary facts. This is a close call, and the verdict is a pass on those measured facts.
